gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rtsod pa zlog pa'i 'khor lo las mdel kha gsang ba'i tan tra
item.coloph: brgyud pa ni 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum dbal dang bzhi/ des lha klu mi gsum snang mdog dang bzhi/ des lha yi gshen gsum/ des zhang zhung gshen gsum/ des rgya bod bsgom (sgom) gshen gsum/ des phrom bod gshen gsum/ des se lde me gsum/ des bla chen dran pa nam mkha'/ des stang chen dmu tsha/ des phyi rabs kyi gshen po pad 'byung nam mkha' rin chen la brgyud pa'o/ shin tu gnyen la zab bo//
